description.value: Coast Mountain Brewing is a craft brewery and tap house established in 2016, situated in Whistler's Function Junction neighbourhood just south of the main village. The venue offers house-brewed mountain beers served from a tap house with a covered outdoor patio. It sits on the Unceded Territories of the Skwxwú7mesh (Squamish) First Nation and is accessible via local transit from the Function Junction bus stop.
